title: Sharpened Snare Cuirass
summary: AC 14 Medium Armour with full Dexterity bonus and specialized restraint support.

fields.Armour Class: 14 + full Dexterity modifier. Medium Armour proficiency. No Stealth disadvantage. Exotic Material may stop working with Medium Armour Master or Magic Initiate: Cleric.
fields.Sharpened Snare: Targets save with disadvantage against Ensnaring Strike, Ensnaring Strands and Garrotte. Fly Trap and Entangle apply it only to saves to escape.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
